spans.s:
(or स्पृध्; cf. √ स्पृह्) cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. ii, 2) स्प॑र्धते (mc. also P. ˚ति; Subj. [प्र॑] -स्पूर्ध॑न्, RV. vi, 67, 9; pf. पस्पृधे॑, ˚धान॑, अ॑पस्पृधेथाम्, RV.; पस्पर्ध, MBh. &c.; aor. अस्पृध्रन्, स्पृधान्द्, RV. : अस्पर्धिष्ट Gr.; fut. स्पर्धिता, स्पर्धिष्यते, ib.; inf. स्प॑र्धितुम्, AV.; Br.; स्पूर्ध॑से, RV.; ind.p. -स्पृ॑ध्य, ib.),
to emulate, compete, rival, vie or cope with (instr. with and without सह, or acc.), contend or struggle for (loc.), RV. &c. &c.:
Caus. स्पर्धयति Gr.:
Desid. पिस्पर्धिषते, ib. :
Intens. पास्पर्ध्यते, पास्पर्द्धि, ib. (अपास्पाः, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 14, Sch.)
contest, competition, battle, fight, RV.
a rival, adversary, ib.
a rival, enemy, BhP.
emulous, vying with (comp.), ib.
desirous of ib.
See √ स्पर्ध्, col. 2.
स्पृधान॑. See root.
स्पृध्य. See मिथ-स्पृ˚.
2. स्पृ incorrect for √ स्पॄ.
(v.l. for √ शॄ) cl. 9. P. स्पृणाति, to hurt, kill, Dhātup. xxxi, 18.
delivering one's self from, removing, avoiding (see किल्बिष-स्पृत्)
gaining, winning (see धन- and लोक-स्पृत्)
a kind of brick, ŚBr.
saved, gained, won, PañcavBr.
= स्पर, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
Trigonella Corniculata, Suśr.; VarBṛS.
2. स्पृश् mfn. (generally ifc.; nom. स्पृक्) touching, coming into contact with (see क्षिति-, शव-स्पृश् &c.)
reaching to (see गगन-, भूस्पृश् &c.)
experiencing, betraying, Kāv.
= स्पृक्का, VarBṛS., Sch.
touching, reaching to (in सर्वद्वार-स्प्˚), MBh.
touch, contact (in दुः-स्प्˚, q.v.)
a kind of plant (= भुजंग-घातिनी), L.
the prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini, L.
= विषय-स्पृश्,
Hariv. 7433
(Nīlak.)
to be touched or felt, tangible, sensible, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
to be taken in possession or appropriated, Rājat.
N. of one of the Samidhs (q.v.), KātyŚr., Sch.
touched, felt with the hand handled, AV. &c. &c.
affected or afflicted or possessed by (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
defiled (cf. comp.)

(in gram.) formed by complete contact of the organs of utterance (applied to all consonants except semivowels [called ईषत्-स्पृष्ट, ‘formed by slight contact’] and except sibilants and ह्, which are called अर्ध-स्पृष्ट, ‘formed by half-contact’), Prāt.; Śikṣ.
स्पृष्ट—ता f. formation by contact (see prec.), VPrāt.
स्पृष्ट—पूर्व mfn. felt or experienced before, MBh.
स्पृष्ट—मात्र mfn. merely touched, MW.
स्पृष्ट—मैथुन mfn. defiled by sexual intercourse, Mn. viii, 205.
a kind of embrace, L.
touching parts of the body (as the feet &c., an asseveration or taking an oath), Mṛcch.; Mcar.
See under स्पृष्टक above.
w.r. for स्प्रष्टव्य, Hit.
mutual touching, touching one another, L. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 2, 27).
touch, touching, contact, ŚBr.
one who has touched, Gaut.

etym.s: [cf. Gk. σπέρχω; Germ. springen; Eng. spring.]

spans.s: 2. स्पृह् See पुरु-स्पृ॑ह् and नि स्पृ॑ह्.
longing for, coveting, striving after, MBh.
to be wished or longed for, desirable, attractive to (gen. or instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
enviable, to be envied by (gen.), R.; Kathās.
स्पृहणीय—ता f.
स्पृहणीय—त्व n. desirableness, enviableness, Kāv.; Rājat.
स्पृहणीय—शोभ mfn. having desirable or enviable beauty, MW.
striving after or eager for any partic. appearance or form, vying in appearance or lustre, RV.
to be striven after or contended for, desirable, RV.
desiring, desirous (= स्पृहयालु), Uṇ. iii, 96, Sch.
= नक्षत्र, ib.
eagerly, desirous, eager, jealous, envious, longing for or to (dat. loc., or inf.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
स्पृहयालु—ता f. (ifc.) desire of, longing for, Śāntiś.
one who envies, an envier of (gen.), Nir., Sch.

(ifc. f(आ). ) eager desire, desire, covetousness, envy, longing for, pleasure or delight in (dat., gen. loc., or comp.; acc. with √ कृ or बन्ध्, ‘to long for, be desirous of [loc. or comp.]’; with √ कृ, ‘to envy any one [loc.]’), MBh.; R. &c.
a kind of plant (v.l. स्पृशा), L.
स्पृहा—वत् mfn. desirous of, longing for, delighting in (loc.), Ragh.; MārkP.
= स्पृहयालु, L.
desired, wished for, longed for, MW.
to be wished for or desired, W.
the citron tree, L.
